paper: MCTS-AHD (Zheng et al., ICML 2025), arXiv 2501.08603 (latest version, v3)
heuristic_framework: ACO (DeepACO implementation); LLM designs the heuristic matrix eta from distance matrix, coordinates, demands, capacity
in_domain_size: N=50 (evaluation dataset D = 10 CVRP50 instances, Table 6)
metric: Mean objective (total route length, lower is better) over 64 test instances, plus Gap %
gap_reference: NOT defined in the paper. Inferred from the numbers: gap relative to the best method in the same column (DeepACO = 0.00% for both CVRP sizes; e.g. ACO 11.355/8.888-1 = 27.76% ~ 27.77%). No exact solver/optimum (HGS/LKH) is used.
llm_and_budget: gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 for all LLM-based methods in this table (paper App. D). Budget: T = 1,000 heuristic evaluations per run ('for almost all tasks', Sec. 4; App. D), 3 independent runs, values averaged over the 3 runs. Baselines (EoH, ReEvo) re-run by the MCTS-AHD authors with 'all their parameter settings' (population M=10) and the ReEvo seed functions for ACO (App. H). Cost reference given only for KP step-by-step: ~3 h, 1M input tokens, 0.2M output tokens, ~0.3 USD with GPT-4o-mini.
aco_settings: 30 ants; 100 iterations during heuristic evaluation; 500 iterations at test time (App. C: 'Numbers of ants and iterations are set the same as TSP'; code eval-test.py: N_ITERATIONS=500, N_ANTS=30).
test_instance_generation: Paper (App. B): follows ReEvo settings, depot fixed at (0.5,0.5). Code (MCTS-AHD repo problems/cvrp_aco/gen_inst.py): capacity 50, demands U{1..9}, locations U[0,1]^2, np.random.seed(1234); order train50(10) -> val20/50/100(64 each) -> test50, test100 (64 each). VERIFIED BY ME: the test50/test100 .npy files committed in the MCTS-AHD repo are NOT the same as ReEvo's test50/test100 (ReEvo generates test20 before test50, shifting the RNG stream); the committed test20 file equals ReEvo's test20 but is not used in Table 2.
provenance: Values read directly from the PDF text (pdftotext -layout); gap reference inferred; dataset mismatch verified by regenerating from the documented spec with my own numpy script and comparing to the committed files.

paper: MCTS-AHD (Zheng et al., ICML 2025), arXiv 2501.08603 (latest version, v3)
problem: Multidimensional knapsack (the paper calls it 'Multiple Knapsack Problem (MKP)', but the instances are n items x m=5 constraints, i.e. multidimensional 0-1 knapsack, same as ReEvo/DeepACO)
heuristic_framework: ACO (DeepACO implementation); LLM designs the heuristic vector from prizes and weights
in_domain_size: N=100 (evaluation dataset D = 5 MKP100 instances, m=5; Table 6)
metric: Mean objective (total prize, higher is better) over 64 test instances, plus Gap %
gap_reference: NOT defined in the paper. Inferred: gap relative to the best method in the same column (MCTS-AHD = 0.00%; e.g. ACO 1-22.738/23.269 = 2.28%). No exact solver/optimum is used.
llm_and_budget: gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18 for all LLM-based methods in this table (paper App. D). Budget: T = 1,000 heuristic evaluations per run ('for almost all tasks', Sec. 4; App. D), 3 independent runs, values averaged over the 3 runs. Baselines (EoH, ReEvo) re-run by the MCTS-AHD authors with 'all their parameter settings' (population M=10) and the ReEvo seed functions for ACO (App. H). Cost reference given only for KP step-by-step: ~3 h, 1M input tokens, 0.2M output tokens, ~0.3 USD with GPT-4o-mini.
aco_settings: 10 ants; 50 iterations during heuristic evaluation; paper says 100 iterations for test sets (App. C). NOTE: the repo's mkp_aco/eval-test.py has N_ITERATIONS=50 and loops over sizes [100,300,500] -> code/paper mismatch, cannot tell which was used for Table 2.
test_instance_generation: Paper (App. B): follows ReEvo; v ~ U(0,1), w_ij ~ U(0,1), C_i ~ U(max_j w_ij, sum_j w_ij). Code: m=5, test seed 4567, 64 instances per size, weights normalized by capacity. VERIFIED BY ME: the committed test100/200/300/500/1000 .npz files in the MCTS-AHD repo are identical to what ReEvo's generator (seed 4567, sizes 100,200,300,500,1000) produces, so MKP100/MKP200 here are the same test sets as ReEvo's.
provenance: Values read directly; gap reference inferred; dataset identity verified.

paper: ReEvo (Ye et al., NeurIPS 2024), arXiv 2402.01145 (latest version, v3)
heuristic_framework: Attention reshaping for autoregressive NCO solvers: POMO (heavy encoder/light decoder) and LEHD (light encoder/heavy decoder); LLM designs a heuristic matrix added to logits. Models trained on CVRP100, generalized to larger sizes; distinct ReEvo heuristic per CVRP size.
instances_per_size: Not stated in ReEvo ('we use the test instances provided by LEHD'); LEHD's CVRP200/500/1000 sets have 128 instances each (from LEHD paper, NOT confirmed in ReEvo)
metric: Mean objective (route length) and Opt. gap (%)
gap_reference: Not stated in ReEvo. Presumably the reference solutions shipped with LEHD's test sets (HGS in the LEHD paper) - inferred, not confirmed.
llm_and_budget: gpt-3.5-turbo (generator and reflector), temperature 1, population 10, 30 initial, max 100 heuristic evaluations (Table 8, default for all ReEvo runs); 3 runs, best on validation tested. ~0.06 USD/run.
provenance: Values read directly. Instance counts and gap reference inferred from external knowledge of LEHD.

paper: EoH (Liu et al., ICML 2024), arXiv 2401.02051 (latest version, v3)
heuristic_framework: Guided Local Search (GLS): LLM designs a function that updates the processing-time matrix and selects jobs to perturb; local search operators relocate and swap; max 1,000 LS iterations, 60 s per instance
metric: Caption: 'average relative makespan (%) to the baseline'; text: 'average gap (%) to the upper bound provided in Taillard (1993)'
gap_reference: Upper bounds from Taillard (1993) per the text (Table 12 caption says 'best-known solutions') - ambiguous
llm_and_budget: GPT-3.5-turbo. 20 generations, population 10 for FSSP, p=5 parents for E1/E2, 5 prompt strategies. Number of heuristic evaluations not stated by EoH for FSSP; MCTS-AHD (App. D) computes it as 810 evaluations for TSP/FSSP (inferred by them from EoH's settings). EoH states ~2,000 LLM queries for online BPP (pop. 20).
test_instance_generation: Training/evolution: 64 random instances, 50 jobs, 2-20 machines, processing times U(0,1) (Pan et al., 2021). Test: Taillard benchmark, 10 instances per set.
provenance: Read directly. NOTE: only one EoH run reported (no mean over runs stated).

paper: EoH (Liu et al., ICML 2024), arXiv 2401.02051 (latest version, v3)

gap_reference: Caption: 'best-known solutions'; text above: 'upper bounds provided in Taillard (1993)'. EoH gets -0.04 on 100x5, which suggests a reference that is not the current BKS (e.g. Taillard 1993 UB) - ambiguous
llm_and_budget: Same as Table 3 (GPT-3.5-turbo, 20 generations x population 10).
provenance: Read directly. Layout transposed here: each row is an instance class, columns are methods. NOTE: the 'PFSPNet' column equals the 'PFSPNet NEH' row of Table 3 (e.g. 20x10 4.04, 50x10 3.48), so it is very likely PFSPNet_NEH, not plain PFSPNet (inferred).

summary: ReEvo T1 (p.5): GLS penalty heuristics, TSP20/50/100/200, opt. gap: KGLS-ReEvo 0.000/0.000/0.000/0.216 vs EoH 0.000/0.000/0.025/0.338, KGLS 0.004/0.017/0.002/0.284. ReEvo T2 (p.7): constructive TSP on 21 TSPLIB instances, avg opt gap NN 25.4, GHPP 16.7, ReEvo 14.6. ReEvo T3: POMO/LEHD + ReEvo on TSP200/500/1000. ReEvo ACO TSP results only in Fig. 2. MCTS-AHD T1 (p.6): step-by-step TSP50/100/200 (1,000 inst., gap to LKH3), GPT-4o-mini MCTS-AHD 9.69%/11.79%/13.71% vs EoH 12.67/14.49/16.68, FunSearch 12.00/13.93/15.54. MCTS-AHD T2: ACO TSP50/100 (64 inst.) MCTS-AHD 5.801/8.179, EoH 5.828/8.263, ReEvo 5.856/8.340, DeepACO 5.842/8.282. MCTS-AHD T8 GLS TSP, T11 TSPLIB, T12 vs LLM-as-optimizer. HSEvo T2 (p.6): GLS TSP100 (64 inst., gap to Concorde) Obj 0.02±0.03 vs ReEvo 0.05±0.06, FunSearch 0.09±0.06, EoH 1.09±3.11. EoH T2/T10/T11: GLS TSP, TSP20/50/100 gap 0.000/0.000/0.025 (1,000 inst.), TSPLIB.

EoH T1 (p.7) / T9: Weibull 1k-10k items, C100/C500, gap to L2 lower bound; EoH 0.80% on 5k C100 (= FunSearch), avg 1.18% in T9. EoH T7: different LLMs (GPT-3.5 0.66, Gemini Pro 0.71, CodeLlama 1.07, DeepSeek 1.41 on 5k Weibull). MCTS-AHD T3 (p.7, GPT-4o-mini, T=2,000): avg gap MCTS-AHD 0.89%, FunSearch 0.99%, EoH 1.17%, HSEvo 1.13%, ReEvo 1.71%.
